questions.question: Can you walk me through a component-level debug or repair you performed on an electronic assembly, including how you used schematics, measurements, and inspection to isolate the fault?
In your Hardware Test Engineer role at Zoom, what programming or testing processes did you overhaul, and what specific improvements did the new process or infrastructure provide?
Describe the in-house test automation framework you developed or maintained. What parts were implemented with Bash, DOS batch scripts, terminal macros, Linux, or Unix tools?

This role involves developing embedded-controller firmware in C. What experience do you have programming electronic components or assemblies, and which programming languages, development environments, or debugging tools did you use?
Describe a time you created or revised a programming or test procedure for a product. How did you ensure that another technician or manufacturing operator could execute it reliably?
What is your experience interpreting digital circuit schematics, and how would you approach tracing signals through a microcontroller-based board during a test or debug investigation?
Tell me about your experience programming and testing electronic assemblies. How did you verify correct behavior and document the test results?

The position requires close collaboration with manufacturing on production documentation. Can you give an example of maintaining assembly records, component kits, procedures, or other documentation used to support manufacturing?
What environmental or stress testing have you performed using test chambers, and how did you determine whether an electronic assembly passed or failed?
This onsite role is based in Parsippany, New Jersey, five days per week. Are you able to meet that onsite work requirement?
